title: Associate Faculty Member
bio: Ahmad (Mo) Khalil is the Hok Lam and Kathleen Kam Wong Professor of Bioengineering, and Professor of Molecular and Cellular Biology at Harvard University. He is also an Associate Member at the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard, and Associate Faculty at the Wyss Institute at Harvard.
